use_case_name: Use case: charging a healthy 400 V pack to its declared full state
preconditions: The pack is at or above its declared minimum state of charge.
The item is fitted and its configuration data matches the pack's build record.
A charger capable of the pack's declared charge rate is connected and respects the limits the item publishes (FB2-ASM-003).

main_success_scenario.action: The charger requests a charge current flow
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item accepts and closes the contactors through the precharge sequence without any safety reaction

main_success_scenario.action: The charger ramps the pack toward its declared full state
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item monitors throughout and raises no entry that forces the safe state

main_success_scenario.action: The charger reaches the declared full state and stops requesting current
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item returns to a resting state with the contactors in their commanded position
At least 98% of the pack's declared usable capacity has been delivered

operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Vehicle parked, charger connected, pack charging at its limit
initial_conditions: Cell-to-cell spread within the declared manufacturing spread
operational_scenarios.perturbation: One cell approaches the configured maximum limit and sits within the measurement noise band of it for longer than the debounce window
operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: The item must not classify this as a violation and must not react, because the cell has not crossed the limit
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: No contactor opening and no fault indication; the charge continues to completion
operational_scenarios.observable_by: The pack manufacturer, from the delivered energy and the item's own fault output
operational_scenarios.safe_state_interaction: Not reached. This scenario tests that the item stays out of the safe state when it should, which is the failure mode a one-directional validation would miss.

postconditions: The pack is at its declared full state and the item is at rest.
No diagnosis entry of a severity that would force the safe state is active.
limitations: This use case is declared, not elicited from a real charging operation. Its 98% delivered-energy figure is an engineering proposal with no basis in a pack specification.

The single operational scenario covers the false-reaction case only. The genuine overvoltage case is the next use case, which is why the pair together covers the detection and the non-detection directions.
No charging has been performed. The measure written against this use case is blocked.
